# Vendored Flare build

This directory contains the compiled, local-only distribution used by the lab to evaluate x402 payment requirements before signing. It was built from the selected Flare repository at commit `eabb15f6a9f31773375069e14d2f21194352ef0b` (`@mssatanass/flare-sdk` version `0.1.0`).

The lab does not include private keys or Flare credentials. Keep the build aligned with the source repository and review its license before redistributing it outside this private lab.
